source: ICAR-DOGR (Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research), National Horticulture Board (NHB)
description: Biological and economic holding constraints for decision support logic

Garwa / Unhali (Rabi).holding_advisability: High — can be safely held in ventilated chawls for 30-90 days

Pol / Rangada (Kharif/Late Kharif).holding_advisability: Low — high moisture content, rots quickly without cold chain

weather_sensitivity.rain_risk: Severe — moisture triggers bulb rot and black mold

Hybrid / Table.holding_advisability: Extremely Low — must sell within 48-72 hours of harvesting

weather_sensitivity.rain_risk: High — causes fruit cracking and fungal infection

Yellow Soyabean.holding_advisability: Very High — farmers can wait weeks or months for favorable price cycle

weather_sensitivity.rain_risk: Moderate — dampness reduces oil content and germination
